newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli shelling kills two in Lebanon, sources.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shelling kills two in Lebanon, sources.

text.p: Israeli shelling killed two civilian men and wounded a woman in south Lebanon on Monday after two Israeli militia allies were wounded in guerrilla shelling, security sources said.

A Lebanese army unit brought the bodies and the wounded woman to a hospital in the southern port city of Sidon after they were hit in heavy Israeli shelling of Berti village east of Sidon, the sources said.
The sources also said Israeli warplanes raided suspected pro-Iranian Hizbollah positions in south Lebanon.
Two Israeli planes fired a total of four rockets at the Hizbollah stronghold of Iqlim al-Toufah ridges, the sources said.
There was no immediate word on casualties .

The Israeli shelling and raid came a few minutes after Moslem guerrillas of Hizbollah fired rockets at a South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia position in Jezzine area wounding two SLA militiamen, SLA security sources said.
Jezzine is officially outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone but under pro-Israeli SLA militia control.
The 3,000-strong SLA militia helps some 1,000 Israeli troops hold a 15-km (nine miles)-deep occupation zone in south Lebanon.
Hizbollah (Party of God) frequently attacks Israeli and SLA posts and patrols in a bid to drive the Israelis from the occupation zone.
